correctness.rationale: The claim is reduced exactly to a clique problem on all 120 permutations. The bundled verifier reconstructs Kendall distance, all 2,940 compatibility edges, all maximal cliques, and an independent exhaustive list of all 5-cliques. Both routes give exactly 168 maxima and exclude size 6. It then directly verifies equidistance, every transformation in the stated 240-element action, the complete orbit split, subgroup closure, and the coset decomposition.

value.rationale: This is a complete equality-case classification for a canonical exact small parameter whose numerical optimum was already known, and it answers the structural direction raised by the exact-parameter paper.
